title: Goldfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- goldfish body dancing, curved pose -->
  <!-- tail fin (back, left side) -->
  <path d='M18 50 Q8 35 5 28 Q15 32 22 42 Q15 50 5 58 Q12 62 20 55 Z' fill='#FF6B35'/>
  <path d='M18 50 Q10 42 8 36 Q16 40 20 46 Z' fill='#FFAA55'/>

  <path d='M20 55 Q12 65 8 72 Q16 68 24 60 Z' fill='#FF6B35'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='50' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#FF9F1C' transform='rotate(-10 48 50)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='56' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#FFD166' transform='rotate(-10 46 56)'/>
  <!-- scales suggestion -->
  <path d='M38 42 Q42 38 46 42' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M48 40 Q52 36 56 40' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M42 48 Q46 44 50 48' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M38 32 Q44 18 54 22 Q50 30 56 34 Z' fill='#FF6B35'/>
  <!-- pectoral fin (dancing arm, upper) -->
  <path d='M58 38 Q70 28 78 24 Q72 36 64 42 Z' fill='#FFAA55'/>
  <!-- lower pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M52 64 Q60 74 66 80 Q60 78 54 70 Z' fill='#FFAA55'/>

  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='43' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- mouth open, happy -->
  <path d='M72 52 Q76 48 78 52 Q76 58 72 54 Z' fill='#FF4D4D'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='38' r='3' fill='#88CCFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='2' fill='#88CCFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#88CCFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d='M30 22 L32 18 L34 22 L38 24 L34 26 L32 30 L30 26 L26 24 Z' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
